events.label: birth
events.text: Born in France; later a painter working mainly in England.

evidence.quote: Parmentier was born in France in 1658

events.text: Went to England to work under decorative painter Charles de La Fosse.

evidence.quote: Parmentier went to England in September 1676

events.text: Became a master of the Guild of St Luke at The Hague.

evidence.quote: He was a member of the guild of St Luke at The Hague , becoming a master on 1 December 1698

events.text: Painted a portrait of St Evremond, now at Knole.

evidence.quote: another of St Evremond ( 1701 ) is at Knole

events.text: Paid £50 to paint a Last Supper altarpiece for Holy Trinity Church, Hull.

evidence.quote: In 1711 he was paid £50 to paint an altarpiece showing the Last Supper

events.text: Returned to London hoping to succeed Louis Laguerre as decorative painter.

evidence.quote: Following the death of Louis Laguerre in 1721 Parmentier returned to London

events.label: death
events.text: Died; buried at St Paul's, Covent Garden.

Painted ceiling and two chimney-pieces in the Binnenhof royal palace (no date)
Accepted invitation to Yorkshire and painted many portraits there (no date)
Painted ceiling for St Peter's Church, Leeds (no date)
Decorated staircases at Worksop Manor for the Duke of Norfolk (no date)
Decorated staircases at the house of John Atkinson, former mayor of Leeds (no date)
